notes.title: UPDATE 1.3 & WHAT'S TO COME!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody!
Thank you for your patience!

Update 1.3 is finally here!
It will be hitting Steam as an update this evening.

Let's talk about what you can expect:

1. A Redone Character Select Screen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/6ce895aed8b9576c9dd4988fb10c31c2c378af43.png

2. Character Portraits in battle!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/917097eccf8ce219dac0ae5d75a83d1ad9ad056a.png

3. TWO NEW QUESTS!
-Jazzy's Stamp Collection: Help a depressed clown track down what he desires most, his lost stamps.
You can start this quest anytime from a new door found in the game room in the Cervantes House.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/dd18266dd1046db3f628e00f1b94fae28e426c8c.png

-The Beast From The Rift: A rift in the lab is unstable, perhaps you could find a stabilizer in the TV station to help out the scientists? You can start this quest late game after completing Gustavo's portion of the main quest, found by accessing a new door in the lab area.
This quest culminates in a hunt for an escaped monster and showdown with one of the hardest bosses in the game, but rewards the player with some of the best armor obtainable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/f6ceb802bdc900f53c53d733d4be76da93568d11.png

4. New Boss Cutscenes!

5. New Pins Added To The Prize Capsule Pool!

6. New Weapons Added To Monster Drops!

7. Two New Achievements!

So What Comes Next For Happy Bones?

So all this being said, the majority of this update that you're not seeing is a framework rework.
I've redone a lot of the variables and switches in order to give me the ability to extend Happy Bones to its fullest capabilities.

This game has the finest community of players and supporters around, and I'm dedicated to making this the best possible experience it can be.

There's many of you who have 100% Completion on this game.

That means you've kept coming back every updated, loaded up your save files, and ventured back into the compound to destroy whatever new demons or adventures I've added.

I appreciate the heck out of that, that's awesome.

So I've decided I want to keep the updates for this game coming.

Therefore let's talk about what's coming with Update 1.4

First of all, by popular demand...I'm excited to confirm the SIXTH playable class for Happy Bones
by showing you a screenshot of what it looks like in battle currently.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/fcf423dbf84478edc20cefb1db099cace71be227.png

Yeah I know.

Awesome right?

The Sixth Class 'The Whisperer' is a culmination of ALL the feedback I've gotten over the last 18 months of this game's lifespan.
The Whisperer is the only class in the game that is able to speak to demons, and is able to win their loyalty over by performing certain tasks.
Therefore it is the only class in the game that will have additional PERMANENT party members, which has been a highly requested feature.

You can even see them following you around outside of battles.
You can even give them cute names (as I have)!

The Whisperer focuses on being able to take care of her team of demons and ensure they are able to take and deal as much damage as possible.

I'll have more details on that class in the near future!

'What Else?'

-More Graphical Improvements!
The new cutscenes are great, and I think I'd like for more of the game to feature visuals such as those that add to the experience.
Additionally I think the new battle UI makes the game feel like a less generic looking RPG, and I'm looking to do the same thing with the menus/inventory.

-A Quest Log
The two new quests in the game are the two highest quality quests in the game, and I'd like to add more, in order to make them as comfortable as possible to keep up with I'll be adding a quest log.


Enjoy the Update.

From the bottom of my heart as always, thank you for playing.

I will have another announcement with more expansion details and screenshots coming soon.

notes.title: Update this Halloween Season!
notes.notes:
Y'all didn't think I'd disappoint for Halloween did you?!

First things first, sorry I've been quiet on here lately.
Even on my Twitter I haven't spoke much publicly.
I've been working on some other projects and finishing my first novel!
I still care deeply for you all.

So let's talk about this update.

The majority of changes this update brings comes from player feedback so let's start there!

Improved Class Select Screen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/6ce895aed8b9576c9dd4988fb10c31c2c378af43.png

Yeah I know, it's a miracle.
You can now freely browse the class select screen without an annoying pop up box every time you move!
Each scroll gives a brief description of the class you're choosing, and players can simply hit ENTER to choose the class now.

Enhanced Cutscenes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/503dac7f1b3808d57429349a4c6579e4eb6cd94e.gif

A few cutscenes have been expanded to give them some more OOMPH! 

Namely some iconic bosses who deserved better and truly posed a greater threat than their intros gave initially gave off.

Expanded Areas!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/e6052c15b103a16591b7eca20092695cc8e228f7.png

A few areas have been slightly expanded offering new NPC's , new tasks, and expanded story...
And of course...

New Monsters!

Like...

Flesh Golem!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/1ac710b94b8e6df817463d52d194c624b5bd7b6a.png
& Dearly Departed!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/5acf3c2365b7737a3d120c3cf8a4fe5683b2f5d9.png

Additionally there will be a slew of new weapons and pins to collect, like this Shrunken Head!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/1a1ee14b8bcc130ab81f5faae0227c740fdd7e03.png

Overall, I believe this update provides a nice new layer of paint for those that have already experienced Happy Bones, and a great addition for any newcomers to experience as well!

Thank You all for everything, many of my supporters have been added to the credits out of thanks for all you do whether it's promoting my work or  simply finding bugs and posting them in the forums.

I hope you all enjoy this update when it releases later this October (before Halloween).

Much Love, and as always thank you for playing!

-FrostedFears

notes.title: Update 1.2 Live!
notes.notes:
Update 1.2 is now live!

The Burglar class is now playable, go enjoy stealing stuff!

You can now check out the "Creation Museum" which includes a new quest
that when completed allows you to summon a robot to lay some serious
beat down on your enemies!

The class select screen has been reworked to look cleaner and give
more info on the classes.

The funhouse is still in development and will include more content than originally
planned, hence why this one was split into two.

Happy Bones still hasn't met the metric yet for Steam Trading Cards and Rewards to be active,
but we're getting there slowly!

Here's a few of them pictured below to keep you satisfied.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/79aaaafe9a443fbd90923518b791c5d65326a6ac.png

Happy Bones iPhone Version has been released and is the full game you'll find on PC, with a few
changes to make the mobile experience more enjoyable!

See ya' soon! :)

notes.title: Content Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, just wanted to keep y'all updated! 

So I've been working on the mobile version of Happy Bones and it's going 
absolutely awesome so far!
The mobile version will have everything the PC and Mac release does, with
a few reworks here and there for the best mobile gameplay experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/f13d21deac5edbeb04f31566480057f7dbb94b2e.png

Don't worry, there won't be microtransactions!  

So while making this version I just had so many new ideas that I went ahead
and put them in as I went, because I'm dedicated to making this an even
better JRPG experience :)

So there's a pretty sizeable content update coming in the next few weeks which
contains the following:

-A new area, the Funhouse!
-New Enemies!
-New Weapons/Armor
-New Events!

And most importantly, my personal favorite...

A NEW CLASS!  

Introducing...the Burglar class! ːsteamhappyː

They're a melee class that specializes in avoiding damage altogether, nabbing items and coins, and
generally offers a very unique play experience from the other three classes.
They'll arrive with their own set of animations for every attack as well :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/4cfbe8fa344b1a81c4c9b1a418584a1bb2c42840.png

The class select screen has been reworked as well!

That's all I have for now, stay tuned and as always...

Thank You For Playing!

notes.title: Mac Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
You can now play Happy Bones on your Mac!

Woo-Hoo!

Several weeks after Happy Bones launched I'm happy to announce that the
Mac version of the game is now available for purchase and play!

I've personally enjoyed playing it on my M1 Mac Mini all day.

As far as future plans go, I still plan on having a small content update to compliment
the mobile version I'm currently working on, more details on that someday.

Not much else to be said right now, as always...

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Happy Release Day!
notes.notes:
Happy Release Day!

Unless you're reading this on 4/15/21, then you've got a few more hours!

First things first, here is a special item code for the dispensing machine in-game!
You can use this to gain a bundle of useful items that will help you in-game once
you get to it! (You'll be able to use one code per game file)

718363

If that's all you came here for, there you go! ːsteamhappyː

Secondly, thank you for supporting smaller developers like us!
It means a lot, and we appreciate the heck out of it.

Finally let's talk business!

For the Mac version of the game, I feel I should clarify that it won't be launching the same
day as the regular Windows version.
It's done but we're working on getting the Steam backend fully functional with it.
It won't be too delayed, so you can likely expect it within the month.

Secondly, future content updates.
I've been asked about DLC by so many people, and I can guarantee there won't be any paid
DLC for Happy Bones, I don't have anything against it, I just wouldn't be a fan of it with
this game.
However, you can expect a small update sometime in the coming weeks to finish out all
the animated enemies that I had mentioned in a previous update post.
With that update will likely come some more content because I also play this game and it's 
cool to get new stuff!

Regarding trading cards, emoticons, badges, etc. they're done but Steam decides when it's time to
let them go live :)
So be on the lookout for those as well!

If you find any bugs or errors while playing, I've made a discussion thread to drop them in and I'll
address them as quickly and reasonably as possible.

Bugs/Errors/Fixes

If you get stuck at any point, I've also made a discussion thread in regards to that, but I promise if
you keep looking around and reading things you'll get going again ;)

Stuck? Hints, Tricks, Secrets (SPOILERS)

notes.title: Update 3/30/21
notes.notes:
So after Happy Bones was finished and having play tested it so many times, I began thinking to myself
what I could do to make the game even more interesting.
I had a lot of options but a few weeks back I was thinking about what I liked about other RPG's with this particular front-view battle style.
Then I was like "Yo, what if these enemies moved? What if they growled at the screen and the maggots squirmed and stuff?"
And we were off.
I began adding basic 3-5 frame animations for most of the enemies in the game, so when you get into a fight with any of them they have a little more life now and I've gotten a lot of awesome feedback on it!

That being said...

Not all of the enemies will likely have animations upon the game being launched, it was a late game development decision but I'm certainly dedicated to getting it done over the course of a few updates.

So here's a few .gif loops below of some enemies and how they look when you encounter them in battle!
They certainly add a little extra flare to the encounter :)
Hope you like them and look forward to you seeing them in game in a few weeks ːojseagullː

notes.title: UPDATE 3/11/21
notes.notes:
Hey there!

We are almost exactly a month out from the release of Happy Bones here, and all the wonderful people testing it out have had some great feedback as well as finding and squashing the bugs.

Something that has been brought up to me was the inclusion of the lighting effects in the game.

One particular tester really enjoyed seeing the hand-drawn environments without the lighting effects, while another tester mentioned that the flickering from the light bulbs began to bother him.

Well, I'm happy to say that you'll have the option to  switch the lighting effects on or off at any point during the game.

You can check out some screenshots showcasing this below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/e89b08450f2c6a92b7fcdeafee72cd5a242cf293.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/ad603a433415cb6bf972e0a7ab91fc89cd77a4f9.png

notes.title: UPDATE 2/17/21
notes.notes:
Hey there!

As I'm typing this out I'm currently freezing my @ss off here in the frozen wasteland that Texas has become this year, so I sincerely hope that if and when you're reading this you're staying warm!

So we are exactly 2 months out from the release of Happy Bones here and I wanted to share a small feature that I think many people will enjoy!

CASINOS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/53ece344751bb5d7da3f12248662a4fcc92ea86a.png

At some point in your adventure you'll likely come upon a slot machine or two, perhaps even an enemy that may even emulate them, but they'll surely be a welcome sight to take a breather and spin the reels of chance a few dozen times.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/bcddb078ee18d80095da521a1cb4e7865cd08319.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/44a9b1e6e74dda106f7ebd59918af4162118c5f4.png

I've always liked them when they've been included in RPG's so I knew at some point I was going to have to put them in, despite what capacity they may be in.

It took a whole day of scripting them out, but I'm happy to say this game has fully functioning slot machines, from low stakes to high stakes! (There's even a HIGHEST Stakes, if your imagination feels the need to ponder what that could be.)

notes.title: UPDATE 2/3/21
notes.notes:
We're about two months out from the release of Happy Bones here and I wanted to share with you another small aspect of the game, Special Item Codes!

At some point in the game you may come across the room shown below with a vending machine on the
far side of the room, if you interact with it, it will prompt you to enter a password!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/fa75d9b2ba7d5f8948b1ce5b30a29b30b35399d3.png

This machine can be used to dispense special items via codes you can find from REALLY paying attention
to stuff in the game, solving puzzles, or here in the community!

For example, if you enter the code below...

264945

You'll receive the Shining Ring which grants you 10% additional experience while worn!

Be on the lookout for more of these codes in these posts, and more announcements leading up
to the release on April 16th!

Stay Classy!

notes.title: UPDATE 1/25/21
notes.notes:
Hey there!

I hope your day is treating you well, and if it isn't I do certainly hope that you're taking steps
to make it as fruitful as you can!

Anyways I figured I'd take a moment to talk about... CLASSES!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/b395776ec8aa9cb19d5b7a8b2c150ab0fb22e245.png

As mentioned in the description on the store page, there's 3 classes!

The Occult, the Brave, and the Holy!

So what's the difference and what does it matter?

Every class will play the game a bit differently, in this game they even have class specific events!
For example the Brave class is able to smash rocks and get past barriers that the Occult and Holy
classes are not able to, usually leading to useful items and shortcuts!

That being said, the Occult can befriend enemies that would normally attack the other two classes, 
and receive gifts from them!

While Holy has an aura that instantly damages some Occult enemies upon entering battle, among 
other things!

Of course there's stat differences as well, Brave is a very bulky class that can take and deal a lot
of physical hits but will take high damage when hit with magic, etc.

Check out the breakdown taken straight from the class select screen below!

notes.title: Update 1/21/21
notes.notes:
Firstly, I would like to thank every last one of you for wishlisting 'Happy Bones' so far, it's received considerably more attention than I had originally anticipated!

Secondly, I wanted to address a question I was asked about where exactly in development this game is!

I finished the game about 2 weeks ago, it's done.

So what am I doing between now and the release in April?

I'm making it better with more content, more enemies, more secrets, and just generally trying to give
what's already an awesome game more flavor!

That ties in to another question I wanted to address,  will there be achievements?

Of course there will be achievements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/efce8123211d4ccd6d932637f55b9f37b8814ead.png

They'll range from simply killing bosses, collecting 99 dead rats, to hunting down a strange posse of clowns. *cough*

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628239/27e89a74c5b1c8649412bee8a57632750f86450e.png

There's going to be a lot to find :)
